text:
sam_ae: FYI customer (Neha @ Acme) just returned MSA+DPA with a handful of redlines and attached a PO. They want the PO, signed MSA, and SOC2 before finance will release payment. asking for net 45 on the PO.
jordan_se: Can you drop the redlined PDF here? I need to confirm the PO matches the POC scope (token caps/throughput) — should we include a short SOW addendum for the POC?
neha_acme: PDF uploaded: https://drive.google.com/acme/redlines.pdf. POC SOW is fine but finance needs PO and signed contract to start billing. Also flagged data residency: EU only.
liz_legal: Skimmed the redlines — main items: 1) SLA uptime request from 99.9 -> 99.95, 2) liability cap removal request (they want full liability), 3) expanded audit right / data access, 4) DPA wants KMS/HSM language. Our starting point: maintain 99.95 for Dedicated customers; hosted stays 99.9. Liability cap = 3x fees or $1M floor.
kevin_revops: From billing: PO number present, invoice to finance@acme.com, net_terms=45. Our standard is net 30; sales-approved net45 okay if deal comms confirm. Who will be the Redwood signer? We'll need name/email for DocuSign routing.
sam_ae: Redwood signer will be Jordan (CRO) or me (AE) for now — legal prefers exec sign for enterprise. Jordan, can you sign?
jordan_se: I can sign. Also quick: confirm whether customer wants Dedicated or Hosted for the POC — affects SLA and data controls.
neha_acme: POC must be Hosted but EU-only data residency. Is that supported?
liz_legal: EU-only on Hosted is tricky — we can do region restriction; need to add a clause limiting replicated data outside EU and include DPA annex referencing EU SCCs. On KMS: we can offer customer-managed keys in Private/Dedicated; for Hosted we provide managed encryption + contractual commitments. Customer wants KMS — is that a hard blocker?
jordan_se: For the POC they said yes but can we scope a short-term workaround: EU region hosted + enhanced logging + SOC2 report, with upgrade path to Dedicated/KMS if they proceed to prod.
kevin_revops: Ok — path looks: (1) accept MSA redlines with SLA concession (we propose 99.9 for hosted POC) and KMS language as "managed keys for hosted; option to migrate to CMK on Dedicated" in the DPA, (2) accept PO net45, (3) DocuSign routing: Customer legal -> Customer finance -> Redwood exec -> Redwood finance (for countersign).
neha_acme: That routing works. Can you push the updated MSA+DPA with our suggested edits highlighted so our legal can confirm quickly?
sam_ae: Will do. Liz — can you draft the compromise redline text for SLA and KMS, and the liability cap language we discussed? I’ll attach and kick off DocuSign.
liz_legal: Drafting now. Proposed language snippet I'll add: "For Hosted POC, SLA 99.9%%. Customer-facing upgrade pathway to Dedicated with CMK support to be negotiated for production contract." Liability cap: "Liability shall not exceed the greater of USD $1,000,000 or three (3) times fees paid in the prior 12 months." Will add standard SCC/DPA annex.
docusign-bot: Envelope 0x9f3d created by sam_ae: Signing order set -> neha_acme (Legal) -> neha_acme (Finance) -> jordan_se (Redwood Exec) -> kevin_revops (Redwood Finance). Link: https://docusign.net/envelope/0x9f3d
kevin_revops: Please confirm finance email for final invoice: finance@acme.com (confirmed). Also need PO attached in envelope.
sam_ae: Attached PO and updated MSA+redlines. Sending now.
neha_acme: Received envelope. Our legal says they still want removal of the indemnity carveouts — can we meet halfway?
liz_legal: We can narrow indemnity to IP infringement + gross negligence; refuse broad removal. I'll propose a limited indemnity clause.
jordan_se: Quick POC checklist for internal ops: EU region assignments, SOC2 upload, reduced token allowance in config, support rotation. I'll ping eng-oncall after signature.
kevin_revops: Once envelope is fully signed, I'll create invoice with PO number and set net45 terms. Sam — can you confirm billing contact is kevin_revops@redwood.com?
sam_ae: Yes.
neha_acme: Thanks team — legal will review the revised clause, aiming to complete signature by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
liz_legal: I'll push the redline now and leave comments for their counsel. Marking this thread as the signature routing tracker.
sam_ae: Perfect. Closing notes: we consent to net45 for this PO, tentative SLA compromise, KMS migration path documented. Will update status when fully signed. :rocket:
